title: SB 23 (112th General Assembly): AN ACT to amend Tennessee Code Annotated, Title 2, Chapter 7, relative to evidence of identification for voting.
operative_text:
(a_in_person_id)
(section) 2-7-112(c)(2) (Sec. 1, replaces subdivision (2))
(quote) (2) A valid identification card that contains a photograph of the voter, and that was issued by this state, or by the United States where authorized by law to issue personal identification;
(section) 2-7-112(c)(8) new (Sec. 2)
(quote) (8) A valid identification card that contains a photograph of the voter, and that was issued by an accredited postsecondary institution of education in this state.
(b_no_id_remedy) not stated.
(c_mail_ballot_id) not stated.
(d_proof_of_citizenship) not stated.
(e_other_rule) not stated.
(other) Sec. 3: takes effect on becoming law.
(other) version: 2222177-Draft: Draft only; adds a postsecondary-institution photo ID to 2-7-112(c) and restates (c)(2).
(other) note: Only the Draft is saved. Last action: referred to Senate State and Local Government 2021-01-13; no roll call saved.
